title: On Appreciating the quiet of the early morning
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：appreciate　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 appreciate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the keeper ① appreciated the quiet of the early morning in silence, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② appreciates the quiet of the early morning twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ appreciate the quiet of the early morning at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ appreciated the quiet of the early morning before — a line in the register for March 1978 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Appreciating the quiet of the early morning in silence, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ appreciate the neighbours for their help twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Appreciate the neighbours for their help at once and never mention it again.

By 1991 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new child from the next zoo ⑧ appreciates the neighbours for their help in silence every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ appreciated the quiet of the early morning again when nobody else would.

⑩ To appreciate the quiet of the early morning, my mother said in 1996, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the zoo remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the zoo forgets, somebody appreciates the quiet of the early morning twice over again and somebody must appreciate the quiet of the early morning in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 欣赏（一般过去式 appreciated the quiet of the early morning：1984 年饲养员头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 欣赏（一般现在 appreciates the quiet of the early morning：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 欣赏（不定式 to appreciate the quiet of the early morning：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 欣赏（过去完成时 had appreciated the quiet of the early morning：1978 年三月的饲养台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 欣赏（动名词 appreciating the quiet of the early morning 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 感激（appreciate the neighbours for their help：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去感激邻居们的那份帮忙）
G. v. 感激（appreciate the neighbours for their help：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 欣赏（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 appreciates the neighbours for their help，而母亲又一次 appreciated the quiet of the early morning）

answers.why: appreciate 意为“欣赏”，1984 年饲养员一言不发地欣赏清晨的那份安静，那是兽舍里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 appreciated。
appreciate 意为“欣赏”，自那以后饲养员来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 appreciates。
appreciate 意为“欣赏”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯欣赏清晨的那份安静”，此处为不定式 to appreciate the quiet of the early morning。
appreciate 意为“欣赏”，饲养台账里 三月 那行字说明早在 1991 年之前就有人欣赏过，故用过去完成时 had appreciated。
appreciate 意为“欣赏”，饲养员说“欣赏清晨的那份安静这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 appreciating the quiet of the early morning 作主语。
appreciate 意为“感激”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去感激邻居们的那份帮忙”，should ever 之后用原形 appreciate the neighbours for their help。
appreciate 意为“感激”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻感激邻居们的那份帮忙（appreciate the neighbours for their help at once），以后再也不要提起。
appreciate 意为“欣赏”，新来的孩子每个季度都照例感激邻居们的那份帮忙，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 appreciates。
appreciate 意为“欣赏”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地欣赏清晨的那份安静，用一般过去式 appreciated 叙述。
appreciate 意为“欣赏”，结尾那句是母亲 1996 年的话：要欣赏清晨的那份安静，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和兽舍记住的那一件。

饲养员说过，一言不发地欣赏清晨的那份安静这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（appreciating the quiet of the early morning 作主语）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 appreciate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the keeper appreciated the quiet of the early morning in silence, and nobody in the zoo forgot it.
Even now the keeper appreciates the quiet of the early morning twice over whenever the zoo asks.
Appreciating the quiet of the early morning in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever appreciate the neighbours for their help twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next zoo appreciates the neighbours for their help in silence every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother appreciated the quiet of the early morning again, and the zoo remembered that half.
